info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' vezwa viluRWane ' iti DAtukAvyavyAKyA ' (1.34) akarmakaH iti ca . vezwanam - granTanam, lowanam - parihARiSca ( pariRAhaSca ( hARam ))' iti kzIrasvAmI . kASakftsnaH DAtumamuM na papAWa .

examples: 'svaM hyEva kopAtpfTivImapImAM saM vezwayeH' (BA0 vana0 10264). saMvezwayeH=saMkocayeH.
'divaM devendra pfTivIM ca sarvAM saMvezwayestvaM svabalenEva Sakra' (BA0 ASva0 9.28).

'Sepa iva nirvezwitaH' (ni0 5.8). anAvfto'saMvfta ityarTaH. niHSabdo DAtvarTaM viparItayati. vezwanamAvaraRaM hi DAtorarTastasya viparyAso'nAvaraRam. ekEkasminmaRqale muhUrtasya dvO dvAvekazazwiBAgO divasakzetrasya nirvezwayan (=hApayan).
'gopAla iva daRqena yaTA paSugaRAnvane. Avezwayata tAM senAM BagadattastaTA muhuH.' (BA0 droRa0 26.63). Avezwayata arundDa.
'CinnA BujAH…udvezwante vicezwante patanti cotpatanti ca' (BA0 karRa 52.25). udvezwante ucCritA Bavanti.
'mahABujagasaMkASA bAhavaH pariGopamAH. udvezwanti vicezwanti saMcezwanti ca sarvaSaH' (BA0 droRa0 89.19).. ukto'rTaH.
'piRqikodvezwakawyUrupAda ruksadanAni ca' (caraka0 ci0 16.14). piRqikodvezwaH piRqikApIqA. jaNGApiRqanistodaH.
'aTa saMtyajato DarmamaDarmaM cAnutizWataH. pratisaMvezwate BUmiragnO carmAhitaM yaTA' (BA0 u0 34.29).. pratisaMvezwate saNkucati.
prAyeRa BamipatayaH pramadA latASca yatpArSvato Bavati tat parivezwayanti. parivezwayanti parikzipanti, samAsajanti.
'ya imAM pfTavIM kftsnAM carmavat parivezwayet' (BA0 droRa0 10.64). parivezwayet saMkocayet. samavezwayaditi pAWAntaram.
'akto'Byakto vezwityupavezwitI kaYcukyupAnahI pAdukI' (Apa0 1.2.8.2). kawipradeSo dvitIyena vAsasA vezwito yasya sa upavezwitI.
